name: Insite AI
author: insitelabsai

sections.description:
Insite AI gives your WordPress site a layer of intelligence it didn’t have before.

Your visitors get a smart assistant that understands what they’re looking for and helps them find it — through natural conversation, semantic search, voice commands, and instant answers drawn from your own content. No generic chatbot responses. No dead ends.

You get a dashboard that shows exactly what they’re searching for, what they can’t find, where your content falls short, and what to fix first. Built for WordPress and WooCommerce.

📊 For Site Owners — Insights That Drive Results

Every interaction on your site generates signal. Insite AI surfaces that signal as clear, actionable insight:

  • Intent Analysis — See why visitors search what they search. Identify high-intent queries, recurring patterns, and what your audience actually wants from your site.
  • Content Gap Detection — Find what visitors look for but can’t find. These are your highest-priority content opportunities, ranked by demand.
  • Content Quality Analysis — AI-scored page analysis with specific suggestions to improve clarity, completeness, and relevance — page by page.
  • FAQ Suggestions — Auto-generated FAQ recommendations based on real visitor questions, ready to publish in one click.
  • Site Health Monitoring — Broken links, missing metadata, duplicate titles, crawl issues — detected automatically and reported with fix suggestions.
  • Weekly Consolidated Reports — A clear summary of visitor behavior, content performance, and improvement priorities delivered to your inbox.
  • Proactive Tooltip — Automatically engage visitors before they leave. Set triggers (exit intent, time on page, scroll depth), customize the message, and define page-specific rules — all from your dashboard.
  • Live Visitor Feed — See who’s on your site right now. Real-time cards showing each visitor’s current page, country, device, and latest search or question. No database storage — privacy-friendly by design.
  • Conversion Goals — Mark any URL pattern as a conversion goal. Track how often visitors who engaged with the assistant completed a purchase, signup, or any target action. Surfaces as “Chat-assisted conversions” in your analytics dashboard.
  • Inbox — View visitor conversations and contact messages in one place. Every lead captured, nothing missed.

The result: higher conversion rates, better retention, and a site that gets measurably better over time.

💬 For Visitors — An Assistant That Actually Helps

  • AI Assistant — Natural language conversations. Visitors get precise, context-aware answers drawn from your actual site content.
  • Smart Search — Semantic search that understands intent, not just keywords. Finds the right page or product even when the query is phrased differently than your content.
  • Smart Navigation — Guides visitors to the right section, page, or product — reducing friction, exits, and “I can’t find it” moments.
  • Voice Commands + Text-to-Speech — Speak a query, hear the answer. Fully hands-free, ideal for mobile and accessibility use cases.
  • Auto-Translator (14 Languages) — The widget detects the visitor’s language and responds accordingly. Supports English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. RTL included.
  • Built-in Accessibility — WCAG-compliant design, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and high-contrast mode — out of the box.
  • Private Mode — Optional privacy-first sessions with no conversation storage. When enabled, all personally identifiable information is stripped client-side before anything leaves the visitor’s browser.
  • WooCommerce Integration — Add to cart, compare products, and get recommendations directly from the assistant — without leaving the current page.
  • Contact Channel — Visitors can reach you directly through the widget. Leads captured without redirecting anyone away from your site.
  • Full Widget Customization — Colors, position, avatar, launcher icon, welcome messages, and behavior — all configurable from your dashboard. No CSS editing required.
  • Proactive Engagement — The assistant reaches out at the right moment. Configurable triggers: exit intent, time on page, and scroll depth — each with a custom message. Page-specific rules let you show the right prompt on the right page.

⚡ Key Features at a Glance

  • No-code setup — connect your site using your API key, done
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • WooCommerce-ready — add to cart and product comparison from the assistant
  • 14 languages with RTL support (Hebrew, Arabic, Persian)
  • GDPR-friendly Private Mode — PII stripped client-side, never transmitted
  • Lightweight — loads asynchronously, zero impact on Core Web Vitals
  • Real-time visitor feed — see live activity as it happens
  • Proactive engagement triggers — reach visitors at the right moment
  • Conversion goal tracking — measure chat impact on real business outcomes
  • No third-party ad networks, no data selling

🎯 Who Is Insite AI For?

  • Content sites and blogs — reduce bounce rate, increase time on site, understand what readers actually want
  • WooCommerce stores — improve product discovery, reduce friction, increase cart conversions
  • SaaS and service businesses — capture and qualify leads 24/7, surface content gaps in your docs and landing pages
  • Agencies — manage multiple client sites with a unified analytics and content quality layer
  • Any site owner who wants to stop guessing and start improving based on real visitor behavior

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/insite-ai/ or install directly via the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Insite AI and enter your API key (create one at insiteai.app).
  4. Configure the widget appearance and behavior from your Insite AI dashboard.
  5. Save — your assistant is now live on your site.

No-code setup — connect your site using your API key, done.
sections.faq:
Is Insite AI free to use?

Insite AI offers a free plan with core features. Paid plans unlock advanced analytics, higher usage limits, and additional features. Full plan details at insiteai.app.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Insite AI has native WooCommerce integration. Visitors can add products to cart, compare items, and get product recommendations directly from the assistant — without leaving the page.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously. It has zero impact on your Core Web Vitals or page speed scores.

What languages does it support?

14 languages: English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. RTL layouts (Hebrew, Arabic, Persian) are fully supported. Language is detected automatically from the visitor’s browser.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. When a visitor enables Private Mode, all personally identifiable information is stripped client-side before anything leaves their browser — nothing is transmitted. Anonymous, PII-free intent signals may still be collected for site insights. No conversation content is stored or linked to any individual. Full details at insiteai.app/Legal?section=privacy.

Does the plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects to the Insite AI platform (insiteai.app) to process visitor queries and deliver assistant responses. An API key is required. Data handling is described in our privacy policy at insiteai.app/Legal?section=privacy. No data is transmitted without active visitor interaction with the widget.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Fully. Colors, position, avatar, launcher icon, welcome message, placeholder text, and behavioral triggers — all from the Insite AI dashboard. No code or CSS editing required.

What is Content Gap Detection?

Every query your visitors make that can’t be answered from your existing content is logged as a “gap.” These are surfaced in your dashboard ranked by frequency. Filling them is the fastest way to reduce exits and improve conversion.

How does Site Health Monitoring work?

Insite AI periodically crawls your site and detects broken links, missing meta descriptions, duplicate titles, and other structural issues. Each issue is reported in your dashboard with a suggested fix.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes. Each site gets its own widget configuration, analytics dashboard, and content analysis. Managed from one account.

Do I need any technical knowledge to install it?

No. Installation is fully handled by the WordPress plugin. Advanced configuration is done through the dashboard, not code.
